title: The canonical facets of multi-separator polytopes
abstract: arXiv:2608.16861v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We initiate a polyhedral study of the graph multi-separator problem proposed by Irmai et al. (2024) as an alternative to the lifted multicut problem for application to the task of image segmentation. Starting with an integer linear program (ILP) formulation and the multi-separator polytope spanned by its feasible solutions, we characterize in terms of efficiently-decidable, graph-theoretic conditions all facets induced by inequalities of the ILP. We proceed by strengthening these inequalities and describing additional facets of some multi-separator polytopes induced by the stronger inequalities. Specifically, we obtain a totally dual integral description of the multi-separator polytope for paths in the case where separation is considered for all vertex pairs. translated_title: 多分隔符多面体的典型面
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16861v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们启动了对图多分隔符问题的多面体研究，该问题由Irmai等人（2024）提出，作为提升多割问题在图像分割任务中的替代方案。从整数线性规划（ILP）公式及其可行解所张成的多分隔符多面体出发，我们以高效可判定的图论条件刻画了ILP不等式所诱导的所有面。我们进一步强化这些不等式，并描述了由更强不等式诱导的一些多分隔符多面体的额外面。具体来说，在考虑所有顶点对分离的情况下，我们获得了路径的多分隔符多面体的完全对偶整数描述。最后，我们将多分隔符多面体与布尔二次多面体联系起来，表明由奇环不等式诱导的面通常不会转移，并与提升多割问题相关联。
tldr: 本文首次系统地刻画了多分隔符多面体的所有面，提出了强化不等式和路径情形的完全对偶整数描述，并揭示了其与布尔二次多面体的关系，为图像分割优化提供了新理论工具。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first systematic characterization of all facets of multi-separator polytopes, proposes strengthened inequalities and a totally dual integral description for paths, and reveals connections to the boolean quadric polytope, offering new theoretical tools for image segmentation optimization.
